title: Chapter 309
text:
There was a small commotion among the players as they whispered to each other.

"I haven't seen any other storyline characters that are over LV 60."

"It's still extremely lethal. The danger level hasn't changed, but was he over LV 60 before? It doesn't feel like it. "

"According to his story, Black Phantom was not strong at the beginning, but he suddenly grew and became the mastermind behind the scenes, destroying the Germinal Organization. This is the uniqueness of the storyline main character."

"Black Phantom's combat power is definitely boss level. I just don't know where his combat power ranks in Blue Star."

The impression that Han Xiao left on the players was that he was very strong, but his actual combat power had always been a mystery. When the players saw Han Xiao's battle videos as they grew, they would always be curious. Now that they were at max level, they could not see his specific attributes, and Han Xiao was about to show his combat power against a professional player. The gap between him and the players could clearly be seen. Everyone's curiosity was drawn out like a glutton, and their hearts were itching.

"It shouldn't be hard to last thirty seconds."

Most of the players, including the selection participants, had the same thought. Although Han Xiao's level was unknown, according to the previous battle videos and his identity as a Version 0 character, they came to a conclusion:

Han Xiao was very strong, but not too strong. The gap between him and the players would definitely be much smaller than before. They were players, after all, and leveled up very quickly.

The first player to be selected for the test was called 'Fallen Leaf', and he stepped forward.

The surrounding players immediately dispersed and cleared out a space. Using force in the main city would normally lower the relationship between factions, but since Han Xiao had chosen this place, it would definitely not be a problem.

Pairs of eyes stared at the field, holding their breaths as they waited.

"It's starting," Han Xiao reminded.

Fallen Leaf immediately got into a battle stance and waited.

Hum!

Four sonic spheres were shot out instantly, flying in a crisscrossing pattern, dazzling the eyes. The configuration was a double penetrator, a shock, and a probe. The probe amplified the area, the shock controlled Fallen Leaf, and the double penetrator released a sonic wave at the same time.

An ear-piercing explosion sounded!

Fallen Leaf's HP dropped by a lot in an instant, and he was stunned and rooted to the ground.

Bang bang bang!

Suddenly, six small booby-trapped turrets appeared in the empty space around them. They opened fire, and the shells fell to the ground with a crackling sound. The firing speed was extremely fast, and the rain of bullets hit them. They flew backward against the fallen leaves and fell to the ground, where they were pressed down by the endless barrage of bullets.

Fallen Leaf's body flickered with the light of energy. He used several skills, but the rain of bullets made it impossible for him to stand up. The Sonic Sphere was also attacking him from the side. All kinds of debuffs such as stun, heavy injuries, and so on appeared on his screen. He couldn't move.

His HP slid to the brink of death in the blink of an eye. His storm-like attacks suddenly stopped as if they had never happened. The scene suddenly became so quiet that even the sound of a pin dropping could be heard.

"You didn't pass the test," Han Xiao said calmly.

Fallen Leaf was stunned. Before he could regain his senses, everything was over.

Everyone's jaws dropped in shock.

Only five seconds had passed! A max level pro player had actually been unable to fight back and had almost been insta-killed!

He couldn't use any flashy moves. He was completely hung up and beaten.

His combat power was completely suppressed!

What shocked the players the most was that Han Xiao had maintained the same posture from the beginning to the end. He had not moved at all!

"Is the Mechanic class so strong? Are we really playing the same class?"

"He hasn't moved at all. How can he control these weapons?"

"His combat power is too out of the ordinary in Version 0. Is it because Blue Star can't restrict him anymore, so he wants to go to the stars?"

"Previous recordings show that Black Phantom still has many combat skills. He hasn't used his full strength yet!"

"His damage is ridiculously high. If we were to fight this boss, I don't know if a fifty-man team would be enough to kill him …"

The same question appeared in the players' minds for the second time, but their mentality was completely different.

What is Black Phantom's level?

Since the start of the open beta, the players had come into contact with Han Xiao when they were still newbies. They thought that after leveling up so many times, the gap between them and Black Phantom would have narrowed. However, in the end, they realized that … Mr. Han was still Mr. Han!

Turning around and seeing the stunned expressions of the players, Han Xiao knew that he had achieved the effect he wanted. He had refreshed the players' impression of him so that they would not become arrogant and think that he could not wield a sword.

Although the players were at the max level, their talents, attributes, and skills were too rare. Simply put, they did not have the bonus of the template. Han Technician was currently at level 70. He was stuck at the requirements of the class change and had not chosen a sub-class. However, he had crossed the level 60 threshold, which was equivalent to the difference of one version. With the addition of the Boss template, his talents, skills, energy, and mechanical power were three to four times stronger. His damage was unbelievable in the eyes of the players.

The average HP of a level 60 player was more than 3,000, and their resistance was average. They were too weak for him.

Furthermore, Han Xiao's Sonic Sphere had also been strengthened to purple grade. Its attack was very high. The Sonic Sphere itself was a very rare equipment in Version 0. It had an independent tactical system, high damage, and strong control.

The faces of the professional players froze.

Li Ge opened his mouth. He thought that it would take a lot of time, but he realized that he was wrong. Black Phantom's speed of eliminating people was as fast as loneliness!

The participants of the selection were no longer relaxed. They were on high alert, and when they heard Han Xiao pick the next person, they all became nervous.

The test continued. These players were very cautious. They moved around the battle and did not dare to fight head-on. Once Han Xiao's attacks landed on them, no one could last more than ten seconds. They all played dirty, hoping to drag out the thirty seconds.

More and more people were watching, and some people were posting live videos on the forums.

The players were used to seeing the outstanding performances of the players. The professional players who were in high spirits and popular a few days ago were now being pressed to the ground. The players were shocked. Then, they felt a sense of novelty.

When had they ever seen professional players line up to be tortured? It was very exciting to see professional players being humiliated in various ways. More and more people were paying attention, and they were watching with great interest.

Han Xiao's strength was also seen by the majority of the players. Various posts created heated discussions about Han Xiao's strength. The happiest ones were the Mechanic players. Originally, the performance of the Mechanic class in the Pro League was very bad, and they were in a bad mood. However, Han Xiao had brought a new dawn to the Mechanic class!

We are so strong when we grow up! You are the lighthouse that illuminates the road ahead!

Han Xiao created a hot topic, and the players found entertainment from it. The serious selection was not serious anymore. However, only famous people could enjoy such treatment. The creativity of the masses was endless, and the players' imagination had no limit. They came up with all kinds of funny headlines.

"Black Phantom: Last thirty seconds if you are a man!"

"Shocking! Professional players can't last thirty seconds after staying up all night! "

"How to last thirty seconds, the professional players have their own ways!"

When it came to creating trouble, the players were the professionals!

"Thirty seconds" became a joke, and "seconds" was spoofed into a unit to quantify a pro player's strength. There were only a few players who passed the test, and they were praised to the heavens as the legendary "Thirty seconds Warrior".

…

Han Xiao only stopped the selection at night and went back to rest. After he left, the players who had been watching the show for a long time gradually dispersed. The time limit of the mission was five days, and today was only the first day. The rest of the players had a lot on their minds and went back to think of strategies.

Han Xiao went back to his room and was about to open the door when he suddenly stopped. He remembered something and went to the room of Mad Blade and the others.

He pushed the door open and entered. Mad Blade and the others were chatting in the room. When they saw Han Xiao come in, they immediately stood up with curiosity.

Normally, Black Phantom would not come to them for no reason. He would only come when there was a mission or reward.

Thinking about the incident in the morning, the four of them had a vague guess. Anticipation appeared on their faces.

As Black Phantom's followers, they had always enjoyed special treatment. Could it be that this time …

Han Xiao laughed and said, "You are all my friends. I am about to leave this planet and go to a bigger world. I will give you a chance to choose. Are you willing to go with me?"

Look at this treatment!

The others could only know that he was about to go to space from the mission introduction, but Han Xiao told them personally without hiding anything. They even had the right to skip the test! How humanistic and caring!
